# exo_contact (Data Source)

Look up an existing Contact object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `assistant_name` (String) Maps to the -AssistantName parameter.
- `city` (String) Maps to the -City parameter.
- `company` (String) Maps to the -Company parameter.
- `country_or_region` (String) Maps to the -CountryOrRegion parameter.

- `mobile_phone` (String) Maps to the -MobilePhone parameter.
